Based on the search results, the Secretary-General of the United Nations in 2015 was Ban Ki-moon. He was succeeded by António Guterres, who served as United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees from June 2005 to December 2015, with Guterres becoming the 9th UN Secretary General on 1 January 2017.
